picks.readme:
# Stitch Design Skills A collection of agent skills and plugins for [Google Stitch](https://stitch.withgoogle.com), following the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) open standard. Compatible with coding agents such as Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode (manual install). ## Quick Start ### 1. Install Plugins (Recommended) The fastest way to set up the full Stitch plugin suite globally. #### Codex Add the Stitch Skills marketplace, then install the plugins you need.
Via CLI (recommended) ```bash codex plugin marketplace add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --ref main \ --sparse .agents/plugins \ --sparse plugins/stitch-design \ --sparse plugins/stitch-build \ --sparse plugins/stitch-utilities ``` > [!TIP] > The `--sparse` flags are optional — they limit the checkout to only the > listed paths for a faster clone. Omit them to pull the entire repository.
Via the Codex UI Navigate to **Settings → Plugin Marketplaces → Add** and fill in: | Field | Value | |---|---| | **Source** | `https://github.com/google-labs-code/stitch-skills` | | **Git ref** | `main` | | **Sparse paths** | *(optional)* `.agents/plugins`, `plugins/stitch-design`, `plugins/stitch-build`, `plugins/stitch-utilities` |
Once the marketplace is registered, install any combination of: - **`stitch-design`** — design-focused skills - **`stitch-build`** — build and component skills - **`stitch-utilities`** — utility and helper skills #### Claude Code & Cursor ```bash # Claude Code — installs into the current project npx plugins add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --scope project --target claude-code ``` ```bash # Cursor — installs into the current workspace npx plugins add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --scope workspace --target cursor ``` #### OpenCode OpenCode does **not** use `npx plugins` / `npx skills` or the Codex/Claude marketplace layout. Install skills and the Stitch MCP server manually: **1. Skills** — copy the skill folders you need into a discoverable path: ```bash # Project-local (recommended) mkdir -p .opencode/skills cp -R plugins/stitch-design/skills/generate-design .opencode/skills/generate-design # repeat for other skills under plugins/*/skills/ ``` OpenCode also discovers `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/` (see [OpenCode skills docs](https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/)). > **Naming:** OpenCode requires skill `name` frontmatter to be lowercase kebab-case and match the directory name. Skills that use `stitch::…` names (or other non-kebab forms) need the `name` field and folder renamed before OpenCode will load them. Extra frontmatter such as `allowed-tools` is ignored. **2. Stitch MCP** — add a remote MCP entry in project `opencode.json` or `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` after completing the [Stitch MCP setup](https://stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/mcp/setup/): ```json { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "mcp": { "stitch": { "type": "remote", "url": "YOUR_STITCH_MCP_URL", "enabled": true } } } ``` Replace `YOUR_STITCH_MCP_URL` with the endpoint from the Stitch MCP setup flow (credentials/env vars from that guide still apply). Tool names inside skill instructions may differ from OpenCode builtins (`webfetch` / `bash` instead of `web_fetch` / `run_command`). Prefer the OpenCode tool names when adapting a skill for OpenCode. ### 2. Install Skills Selectively Choose only the specific skills you need. > [!IMPORTANT] > Stitch Design Skills often have inter-dependencies. If you choose to install skills selectively, ensure you include all required dependencies. ```bash npx skills add google-labs-code/stitch-skills ``` You can run the following commands to see the help documentation for plugins and skills: ```bash npx plugins --help npx skills --help ``` ## Prerequisites These skills require the **Stitch MCP** server to be co

picks.readme:
# AI 角色参考与合成工作台 · 中文版（3合1）

> **姿势库（1,439 张素体白模 + 1,439 张深度图 Depth） + 服装库（3,224 套：ギア写实 1,407 + Shisei 中国历代 57 套/227 视角 + ギア动漫 1,320 + CharaDB 二次元 440） + 人像库（1,499 位） = 6,162 条全中文参考数据 / 12,022 张本地高清图，另有 1,760 张来源站点参考图**，集成 **5 大 AI 图像协议直连工作台** 与 **原生 ComfyUI 自定义节点插件（`custom_nodes`）**。

![画廊总览预览](docs/preview.jpg)

![AI 角色合成台预览](docs/studio.jpg)

<details><summary>手机端预览</summary>

![手机端预览](docs/mobile.jpg)

</details>

**在线演示：** <https://ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app/>
**原始站点：**
- 姿势库（白模）：<https://ai-pose-gallery.pages.dev/>
- 姿势深度图库（Depth）：<https://ai-pose-depth-gallery.pages.dev/>
- 服装库：<https://ai-costume-gallery.pages.dev/>
- 人像库：<https://ai-portrait-gallery.pages.dev/>

**原有图库作者：** ギア（@giaaibusi）；二次元服装作者：たき AI（[@taki_auto](https://x.com/taki_auto) · [CharaDB](https://charadb-2fi.pages.dev/)）。
**中文版维护：** Anhao · [X @anhao_ai](https://x.com/anhao_ai)
**GitHub：** <https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh>

> ⚠️ **免责声明（必读）**：
> 1. **学习与创作限定**：本项目及配套插件/工作流**仅供个人学习、人体动态研究、合法艺术创作与技术交流使用**，严禁用于任何违反法律法规、生成违法违规/淫秽色情内容或侵害他人合法权益（如未经授权的真人肖像换脸）的用途。
> 2. **NSFW 敏感内容提示**：图库包含部分 18+ 成人向人体素体姿势与内衣/性感穿搭参考，系统默认开启「安全模式 (SFW)」隐藏，**未成年人严禁解锁或访问**。
> 3. **来源与版权声明**：原有姿势、现实服装、人像参考图源自原作者 **ギア（@giaaibusi）** 公开站点；440 套二次元服装源自 **たき AI（@taki_auto）** 的 [CharaDB](https://charadb-2fi.pages.dev/)（详见其 [LICENSE](https://github.com/taki-ttt/charadb/blob/main/LICENSE)），版权归各自原作者所有；本仓库仅为中文翻译整理与工程学习存档，禁止将图库图片打包倒卖。使用者因违规使用产生的一切法律责任由使用者本人独立承担。

---

## 这是什么

原站是ギア（@giaaibusi）发布的三大 AI 绘画参考图库（姿势、服装、人像），元数据全部为日文，且分散在三个独立站点。本仓库（v2.0）完成了**三站合一、全量中文化、AI 角色合成工作台与 ComfyUI 原生插件升级**：

1. **三库四站全量本地镜像（11,568 张图）** —— 完整收录姿势库（素体白模 2,878 张 + 深度图 Depth 2,878 张 WebP）、服装库（2,814 张 WebP）、人像库（2,998 张，全尺寸 `1600×2000` 高清 WebP）的全部缩略图与高清原图，支持纯离线浏览与静态托管。
2. **原有图库全中文元数据** —— 动作体系、姿势分类、服装款式、穿搭标签、人像分区、发长与 51 种细分发型全部译为地道中文，自动组装的生图提示词纯净无日文干扰。
3. **三合一 AI 角色合成工作台（Web Studio）** —— 基于 **React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript 7 + shadcn/ui + TanStack Router** 构建的响应式多页面应用（兼容 PC / 平板 / 手机）：
   - 从三大图库任意挑选 **人像 + 服装 + 姿势（支持素体白模 / 深度图一键切换）** 组合配方，或一键随机捏人；
   - 支持拖拽、剪贴板粘贴（`Cmd+V` / `Ctrl+V`）或 URL 添加多张自定义附加参考图；
   - 内置 **5 大 AI 图像协议直连**（Google Gemini、OpenAI GPT Image、阿里云百炼 Qwen、字节火山方舟 Doubao、**本地 ComfyUI**），生成记录通过 **IndexedDB** 本地持久化保存。
4. **原生 ComfyUI 自定义节点插件（`custom_nodes`）** —— 本仓库同时是一个即插即用的 ComfyUI 插件！直接 `git clone` 到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/` 即可在 ComfyUI 画布内使用 **姿势 / 服装 / 人像 / 三合一角色配方** 4 个自定义节点（姿势与配方节点内置 `use_depth` 深度图切换，可直接接入 ControlNet Depth）与内置的 **6,162 条中文可视化弹窗选图器**。

---

## 核心功能

### 1. 三大参考图库（姿势 / 服装 / 人像）
- **姿势参考库（`/poses`）**：4 大体系（全身单人・标准系 / 全身单人・性感系 / 上半身单人 / 双人缠绵）、26 个动作分类、288 组姿势、5 种视角（正面 / 斜前 / 侧面 / 背面 / 俯视），支持**按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式、卡片内多角度切换，以及 **`[ 素体白模 | 深度图 (Depth) ]` 一键切换预览与下载**。
- **服装参考库（`/costumes`）**：8 大穿搭分类（春季 / 夏季 / 秋季 / 冬季 / 内衣・睡衣 / 性感穿搭 / 泳装・度假 / 派对・礼服）、86 个中文细节标签与英文 Prompt 关键词。
- **人像参考库（`/portraits`）**：2 大分区（正脸参考 893 / 造型氛围 606）、4 种发长（短发 / 中发 / 中长发 / 长发）、51 种细分发型，支持**精选题集**与**热门榜单**一键筛选。
- **统一交互体验**：中文关键词实时检索、灯箱高清原图预览与下载、一键「加入合成配方」。

### 2. AI 角色合成台（`/studio`）
- **3+N 参考图组合**：3 个核心槽位（人像 / 服装 / 姿势，姿势槽位内置 `[ 白模 | 深度 ]` 实时切换）+ 任意张自定义附加参考图（点击上传、拖拽文件、剪贴板粘贴、填写图片 URL）。
- **参考拼图预览与导出**：弹窗查看三合一高清参考拼图（`1800×1200` Canvas 实时合成），支持一键下载拼图 PNG。
- **12 种画风预设 & 纯中文结构化提示词**：内置「无预设（跟随参考图）」、写实人像写真、日韩杂志画报、复古胶片写真、2.5D 游戏原画立绘、日系二次元插画、新海诚感动画电影、日式黑白漫画网点、3D 次世代角色渲染、3D 潮玩手办质感、赛博朋克霓虹、角色设定集立绘（纯白底）共 12 种画风，根据已选素材自动组装提示词。
- **5 大 AI 图像协议与高级参数**：
  - **Google Gemini**：`gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview`、`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`、`gemini-2.5-flash-image`（支持宽高比 `aspectRatio`、分辨率 `1K/2K/4K`）
  - **OpenAI GPT Image**：`gpt-image-2.5`、`gpt-image-2`、`gpt-image-1.5`、`gpt-image-1`（支持 `/v1/images/edits` JSON URL 直传 / Multipart 上传、尺寸、质量、背景透明度）
  - **阿里云百炼 Qwen**：`qwen-image-3.0-pro`、`qwen-image-2.1-pro`、`qwen-image-2.0-pro`、`qwen-image-edit-plus`（支持 `multimodal-generation` 多图参考输入、智能改写 `prompt_extend`、水印开关）
  - **字节火山方舟 Doubao**：`doubao-seedream-5-0`、`doubao-seedream-4-5-251128`、`doubao-seedream-4-0-250828`、`doubao-seededit-3-0-i2i-250628`（支持多图融合 `image: [...]`、2K/4K 分辨率）
  - **本地 ComfyUI 工作流引擎**：支持自动将三合一拼图及单张人像/服装/姿势图

picks.name: kiri
picks.desc: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative
picks.readme:
Kiri: a tiny, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux

Docker Desktop is slow to start and heavy when idle. Kiri is a lightweight replacement written in Rust. It runs your Docker images and works with the docker CLI, Compose and buildx you already use.

Quickstart · Docs · Features · Download · Security

--- ## Before you begin Make sure you have one of: - macOS 14 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel - Windows 10 or 11 with WSL 2, on x86-64 or Arm - Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora and others) ## Step 1: Install and start Kiri macOS, with Homebrew: ```bash brew install --cask libracoder/kiri/kiri ``` Or download the installer for your system: | Platform | Get it | |----------|--------| | macOS 14+ (Apple silicon or Intel) | `.dmg` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/), or `brew install --cask libracoder/kiri/kiri` | | Windows 10 and 11 (x86-64 or Arm, through WSL 2) | `.msi` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | | Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora and others) | `.deb` or `.rpm` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | The first time you open Kiri, it sets up a `kiri` Docker context. Kiri updates itself, and checks each new release's signature first. Then run your first container: ```bash docker --context kiri run --rm alpine echo hello ``` --- ## Table of Contents - [Before you begin](#before-you-begin) - [Install and start Kiri](#step-1-install-and-start-kiri) - [Why Kiri?](#why-kiri) - [Quick Start](#quick-start) - [Features](#features) - [Docker commands](#docker-commands) - [Benchmarks](#benchmarks) - [Comparison](#comparison) - [How Kiri Works](#how-kiri-works) - [Documentation](#documentation) - [Roadmap](#roadmap) - [Community](#community) - [Security](#security) - [License](#license) --- ## Why Kiri? Kiri runs containers in one small Linux VM (or straight on the kernel on Linux) and speaks the Docker Engine API, so your tools just work. The name comes from the Igbo word *ntakịrị*, "small". - **Fast**: a container starts and exits in about 2.5 ms through the Docker API. That's around 80 times faster than Docker Desktop. - **Light**: the VM sleeps after 60 s idle, the daemon stays at about 15 MB, and it wakes in about 0.15 s. - **Compatible**: `docker`, Compose, buildx, `docker login` and amd64 images through Rosetta. - **Local domains**

picks.readme:
# TotK Recomp

**TotK Recomp** is a static recompilation of *The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom* (Nintendo Switch, 2023) into a native x86-64 application for Windows and Linux ([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No game files are included.** You need your own legally obtained copy of *Tears of the Kingdom*, dumped from your own console: the base game and the 1.1.0, 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update. Instructions for obtaining those files will not be provided.
>
> The game is built from your files on your machine, so the result contains the game. It is for your own use. Do not share it.

## Status

Early development. The game is playable on Windows and Linux; visual bugs and crashes are still expected.

Report problems as issues, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Features

- Native code, not emulation
- Game updates 1.1.0, 1.2.1 and 1.4.3; 1.2.1 and 1.4.3 saves carry over between them
- Takes NSP and XCI game files, and compressed NSZ and XCZ as they are: the setup unpacks them itself
- 60 fps by default; up to 144 fps or the monitor's refresh rate (experimental)
- Custom resolutions (1080p, 2k...), supersampling and AMD FSR 1 upscaling
- NVIDIA DLSS / DLAA on RTX GPUs: the setup downloads `nvngx_dlss.dll` from NVIDIA's DLSS SDK repository
  (github.com/NVIDIA/DLSS, NVIDIA RTX SDK license) when it finds an RTX GPU; untick it in the setup to skip it
- HDR10 output with peak, game and HUD brightness settings
- 16:10 (Steam Deck, handhelds), 3:2 (Surface, Framework), 21:9 and 32:9 (ultrawide) game resolutions, with the camera and the interface in that shape
- Anisotropic texture filtering up to 16x, for sharp ground into the distance
- In-game settings menu (F1) and performance overlay (F10)
- Play time across runs on the Game tab of the settings menu, kept in `playtime.txt` next to the saves
- Discord Rich Presence ("Playing TotK Recomp" with the play time), off by default, own application id supported
- Setup in 11 languages, in-game menu in 4 ([Languages](#languages))
- Keyboard, mouse and gamepad with remapping, rumble and gyro
- Stereo or 5.1 surround sound output
- Xbox and PlayStation button prompts: Xbox's LB, RB, LT, RT, Menu, View and A, B, X, Y, or PlayStation's ○ × △ □, L1, R1, L2, R2, Options and Share, as labelled on the button to press, with either button layout
- Shaders prepared at install instead of during play
- Mods made for emulators: unpack a mod into the `mods` folder next to `totk.exe`; switch and order them in the menu. RomFS
  mods, TKMM's merged output and ExeFS code patches (`.ips`, `.pchtxt`) work; the game rebuilds itself for code patches
  ([docs/mods.md](docs/mods.md)). HD texture packs work: the port grows the texture heap a pack asks for by itself. Tested
  with the HDPacks.com 4K Texture Pack v1.0 on 1.4.3 and 1.2.1; other packs come with no guarantee
- Atmosphère cheats: put a cheat file into a mod and switch its cheats in the menu ([docs/cheats.md](docs/cheats.md))

## Languages

The game keeps the text and voices of every language it shipped with. The port's own setup and in-game menu (F1) come
in these; both follow the Windows display language, and the menu has its own choice on its Menu tab. A Traditional
Chinese Windows gets the Simplified Chinese setup.

| Language | Setup | In-game menu |
|---|:---:|:---:|
| English | ✅ | ✅ |
| Русский | ✅ | ✅ |
| Português (Brasil) | ✅ | ✅ |
| 简体中文 | ✅ | ✅ |
| Deutsch | ✅ | English |
| Français | ✅ | English |
| Español | ✅ | English |
| Italiano | ✅ | English |
| Nederlands | ✅ | English |
| 日本語 | ✅ | English |
| 한국어 | ✅ | English |

Spotted a clumsy phrase, or want your language added? The setup texts are in `installer/text/<language>.json`, the
menu texts in `runtime/ui_text.c`; open an issue or a pull request ([CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)). Fixes from
native speakers are welcome.

## Planned

--- ## What is this? `claude-bughunter` is a drop-in skill bundle for the [Claude Code skills system](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/skills). Install once and Claude Code stops being a chatbot and starts behaving like a senior bug-hunting researcher or red-team operator: it knows the techniques, the chain templates, the VRT mappings, the platform CVE chains, and the hygiene — and it stays in scope. Four layers stack: - **Think** — `bb-methodology` + `redteam-mindset`: the 5-phase non-linear workflow, critical-thinking framework, and red-team operator discipline. - **Hunt webapps** — 58 `hunt-*` skills curated from 681 disclosed HackerOne reports: per-class detection patterns, payloads, bypass tables, and chain templates. - **Hit the perimeter** — enterprise platform chains (M365/Entra, Okta, vCenter, SSL-VPN appliances, SharePoint, cloud IAM): current 2024–2026 CVE chains + post-credential escalation. - **Ship it** — `triage-validation` + reporting + `evidence-hygiene`: the 7-Question Gate, VRT-aware severity, OOS rebuttals, PII redaction, and red-team deliverables. All triggered automatically by topic — describe what you're testing in plain English and the relevant skill loads. No invocation by name. --- ## Quickstart **Option A — install as a Claude Code plugin (recommended).** From inside Claude Code: ```text /plugin marketplace add elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter /plugin install claude-bughunter@elementalsouls ``` All 83 skills + 15 commands load namespaced under `claude-bughunter:` and update when you bump the plugin version — no files copied into `~/.claude/`. **A HackerOne account is optional.** The install asks for a HackerOne API username and token. They only let the HackerOne MCP read your private programs and your own reports; leave both blank if you don't need that. # Superpowers

Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

## Table of Contents

- [How it works](#how-it-works)
- [Commercial Services](#commercial-services)

- [Philosophy](#philosophy)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [Updating](#updating)
- [License](#license)
- [Visual companion telemetry](#visual-companion-telemetry)

## How it works

It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it *doesn't* just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do. 

Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest. 

After you've signed off on the design, your agent puts together an implementation plan that's clear enough for an enthusiastic junior engineer with poor taste, no judgement, no project context, and an aversion to testing to follow. It emphasizes true red/green TDD, YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It), and DRY. 

Next up, once you say "go", it launches a *subagent-driven-development* process, having agents work through each engineering task, inspecting and reviewing their work, and continuing forward. It's not uncommon for your agent to work autonomously for a couple hours at a time without deviating from the plan you put together.

There's a bunch more to it, but that's the core of the system. And because the skills trigger automatically, you don't need to do anything special. Your coding agent just has Superpowers.

## Commercial Services

If you're using Superpowers in enterprise and could benefit from commercial support, additional tooling, or managed spending, please don't hesitate to drop us a line at sales@primeradiant.com.

## Installation

Installation differs by harness. If you use more than one, install Superpowers separately for each one.

### Claude Code

Superpowers is available via the [official Claude plugin marketplace](https://claude.com/plugins/superpowers)

#### Official Marketplace

- Install the plugin from Anthropic's official marketplace:

  ```bash
  /plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official
  ```

#### Superpowers Marketplace

The Superpowers marketplace provides Superpowers and some other related plugins for Claude Code.

- Register the marketplace:

  ```bash
  /plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace
  ```

- Install the plugin from this marketplace:

  ```bash
  /plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace
  ```

### Antigravity

Install Superpowers as a plugin from this repository:

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/obra/superpowers
```

Antigravity lists each installed skill's description, and the description of
the `using-superpowers` skill prompts the model to load that skill at the start
of a conversation. Reinstall with the same command to update.

### Codex App

Superpowers is available via the [official Codex plugin marketplace](https://github.com/openai/plugins).

- In the Codex app, click on Plugins in the sidebar.
- You should see `Superpowers` in the Coding section.
- Click the `+` next to Superpowers and follow the prompts.

### Codex CLI

picks.name: AFFiNE
picks.desc: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
picks.readme:
AFFiNE.Pro
Write, Draw and Plan All at Once


A privacy-focused, local-first, open-source, and ready-to-use alternative for Notion & Miro.
One hyper-fused platform for wildly creative minds.





Home Page | Discord | Live Demo | Blog | Documentation

[![Releases](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/toeverything/AFFiNE/total)](https://github.com/toeverything/AFFiNE/releases/latest) [![All Contributors][all-contributors-badge]](#contributors) [![TypeScript-version-icon]](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)

Docs, canvas and tables are hyper-merged with AFFiNE - just like the word affine (əˈfʌɪn | a-fine).

## Getting started & staying tuned with us. Star us, and you will receive all release notifications from GitHub without any delay! ## What is AFFiNE [AFFiNE](https://affine.pro) is an open-source, all-in-one workspace and an operating system for all the building blocks that assemble your knowledge base and much more -- wiki, knowledge management, presentation and digital assets. It's a better alternative to Notion and Miro. ## Features **A true canvas for blocks in any form. Docs and whiteboard are now fully merged.** - Many editor apps claim to be a canvas for productivity, but AFFiNE is one of the very few which allows you to put any building block on an edgeless canvas -- rich text, sticky notes, any embedded web pages, multi-view databases, linked pages, shapes and even slides. We have it all. **Multimodal AI partner ready to kick in any work** - Write up professional work report? Turn an outline into expressive and presentable slides? Summary an article into a well-structured mindmap? Sorting your job plan and backlog for tasks? Or... draw and code prototype apps and web pages directly all with one prompt? With you, [AFFiNE AI](https://affine.pro/ai) pushes your creativity to the edge of your imagination, just like [Canvas AI](https://affine.pro/blog/best-canvas-ai) to generate mind map for brainstorming. **Local-first & Real-time collaborative** - We love the idea of local-first that you always own your data on your disk, in spite of the cloud. Furthermore, AFFiNE supports real-time sync and collaborations on web and cross-platform clients. **Self-host & Shape your own AFFiNE** - You have the freedom to manage, self-host, fork and build your own AFFiNE. Plugin community and third-party blocks are coming soon. More tractions on [Blocksuite](https://blocksuite.io). Check there to learn how to [self-host AFFiNE](https://docs.affine.pro/self-host-affine). ## Acknowledgement “We shape our tools and thereafter our tools shape us”. A lot of pioneers have inspired us alon

picks.plain: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.

analy.en: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
analy.zh: 除了 Notion 和 Miro，还有更多选择。AFFiNE（发音为 [ə‘fain]）是一款新一代知识库，将规划、整理和创作融为一体。隐私至上、开源、可定制且开箱即用。
analy.plain: 说白了，这是一个打开网页就能用的在线小工具，不用装任何东西。它干的事是：除了 Notion 和 Miro，还有更多选择。AFFiNE（发音为 [ə‘fain]）是一款新一代知识库，将规划、整理和创作融为一体。隐私至上、开源、可定制且开箱即用。
usage: 把散落的资料整理成结构化文档
直接打开当工具用，省掉装软件那一步
部署到自己的域名，做成一个能对外收钱的服务
how: 打开作者给的网址（或自己部署一份）
按界面提示把内容填进去
选样式/导出，拿到成品
analy.gap: 部署一个公开 demo，让人先玩再决定买不买
analy.why: 要整理归档资料的人不是不会做，是懒得为这一步花两三天试错。你把「部署一个公开 demo，让人先玩再决定买不买」替他们做完，他们花的钱远少于自己折腾的时间。
analy.self: 自己干活时当外挂：重复的排版、出图、整理交给它，一次省十几分钟。用熟之后你会清楚自己哪一步最该自动化——这个认知比工具本身值钱。
analy.pack: 汉化 + 一套中文模板 + 部署教程，打包成 zip 发网盘；主图用「改前 vs 改后」对比，标题写用户能搜的词。落地上就按这条走：做成在线服务，按月收使用费。
